summary: Completed comprehensive testing of QUESTEDUCA educational game. Fixed critical bug in backend authentication dependency injection. All 23 backend API tests pass. Frontend flows (registration, login, parent dashboard, child creation, subscription checkout) working correctly.

fixed_bugs.issue: Authentication dependency injection broken - lambda function incorrectly defined
fixed_bugs.fix: Created proper get_current_user_dep async function instead of lambda
fixed_bugs.impact: All authenticated endpoints were returning 422 errors

fixed_bugs.fix: Added StudentCreateResponse model with temp_password field
fixed_bugs.impact: Parents couldn't see temporary password for child accounts

issues: Minor React hydration warning about span inside option element - cosmetic only, doesn't affect functionality

passed_tests: API /api/schools returns schools with filter by district and cycle/year
API /api/subscriptions/prices returns correct prices (1.99€ individual, 4.99€ family)
Parent dashboard - tabs navigation (Visão Geral, Meus Filhos, Subscrição)
Parent dashboard - child creation with school year filtering
Parent dashboard - subscription checkout buttons redirect to Stripe
School filtering by year (5th year correctly maps to 2º ciclo schools)
critical_code_review_comments: The lambda dependency injection pattern was incorrect and has been fixed
Consider adding more comprehensive error handling for Stripe webhook events
seed_data_creation: Test users created during testing with TEST_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend authentication dependency was fixed. All core flows working: registration, login, parent dashboard, child creation with school filtering, Stripe checkout. The app uses Portuguese language throughout. Stripe is in test mode (sk_test_emergent).

test_credentials.note: Test accounts created during testing with random emails

verified_features.districts_api: Returns 20 Portuguese districts with correct structure
verified_features.schools_api: Returns 243 schools, filters by district and cycle/year correctly
verified_features.parent_registration: Works with role selection, password confirmation
verified_features.child_creation: Works with school year to cycle mapping, school filtering
verified_features.stripe_checkout: Redirects to Stripe checkout with correct amount
